relationships.evidence_quote: optogenetic activation (10 Hz/5 ms and 20 Hz/15 ms, laser 465 nm) of DRNGABA neurons increased the mechanical pain threshold in OVX mice

relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that E2 alleviates hyperalgesia induced by ovarian hormone withdrawal, probably by increasing the excitability of DRNGABA neurons.

relationships.subject: DRN GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Optogenetic stimulation (465-nm light)–evoked oIPSC was recorded in LPBN neurons by stimulating ChR2 terminals from the DRNGABA neurons

relationships.subject: ovarian hormone withdrawal
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that the excitability of DRNGABA neurons is decreased in OVX mice

key_findings: Ovariectomy decreases activity and excitability of DRN GABAergic neurons, causing mechanical hyperalgesia.
Activating DRN GABA to LPBN projection or E2 in DRN alleviates OVX hyperalgesia.
